arm-translation.title: Por favor, baixe a versão ARM ao invés desta.
arm-translation.message: Você está usando {APP_NAME} através de uma camada de tradução como Apple Rosetta. Por favor, instale a versão nativa em ARM ao invés de continuar usando esta versão pois funcionará melhor e economizará bateria.
unnecessary-legacy.title: Please don't use the legacy version
unnecessary-legacy.message: You are using the 'Legacy' version of {APP_NAME} on a device that doesn't need to. This is insecure, slower, and may PERMANENTLY delete your settings and backpack. Please install the normal version instead.

desktop-settings.title: Configurações de área de trabalho
desktop-settings.update-checker-not-allo: As atualizações são gerenciadas pela loja de onde você instalou o aplicativo.

desktop-settings.media-devices-changed: Você deve reniciar o programa para aplicar as alterações de câmera e microfone.
desktop-settings.hardware-acceleration-w: Use graphics acceleration when available (requires restart)
desktop-settings.hardware-acceleration-d: Disabling graphics acceleration significantly reduces performance. Some projects can run over 100x slower as all rendering will be done by your CPU. This should only be done as a last resort if graphics acceleration is causing crashes.
desktop-settings.background-throttling-d: Permitir que janelas ocultas se permaneçam ativas irá ocasionar o uso elevado da CPU e duração menor da bateria.
desktop-settings.bypass-cors: Permitir que extensões acessem qualquer site
desktop-settings.bypass-cors-enabled: Isso desativará múltiplas funcionalidades de segurança que servem para sua proteção. Logo, terá riscos de projetos ou extensões mal intencionadas poderem acessar qualquer site ou dispositivo em sua rede.

desktop-settings.rich-presence-unavailab: Rich Presence is not available in this version of the app
desktop-settings.top-bar-device-stats: Show device usage in top bar
desktop-settings.top-bar-device-stats-de: Display the CPU and memory usage indicator in the editor's top bar. Toggles apply immediately and the bar re-centers automatically
desktop-settings.context-menu-glass: Frosted glass effect in context menus
desktop-settings.context-menu-glass-desc: Show the editor's right-click menu with a translucent blurred background. Toggles apply immediately without restarting
desktop-settings.check-for-updates-desc: Manually check for the latest version
desktop-settings.no-update: You are using the latest version!
desktop-settings.language-desc: Choose the language used by the NeoWarp interface. Takes effect immediately.
desktop-settings.assoc-sb3-desc: Open Scratch projects in NeoWarp when double-clicked
desktop-settings.assoc-js-desc: Open NeoWarp JavaScript extensions in NeoWarp when double-clicked
desktop-settings.associations-note: Changes apply immediately. If another app is currently the default for these files, Windows may ask which app to use the next time you open one.
desktop-settings.associations-unsupporte: File associations can only be managed on Windows.
desktop-settings.ui-theme-desc: Applies to the editor, SOLO and tool windows
desktop-settings.toolbar-height-desc: Height of the editor's top toolbar. Narrow fits more of the project on screen
desktop-settings.compact-window-style-de: Merge the minimize/maximize/close buttons into the editor's top toolbar. Only affects the editor window
desktop-settings.home-logo-desc: The logo on the left side of the home page. Use an image or custom HTML
desktop-settings.home-text-desc: The text below the logo. Leave empty for the default
desktop-settings.home-reset-desc: Restore the default home page logo, title text and background
desktop-settings.home-background-desc: A custom background image for the home page. Buttons switch to a liquid glass style
desktop-settings.show-recent-projects-de: Show recently opened Scratch and extension projects below the buttons on the home page

downgrade-warning.title: Downgrading is not supported
downgrade-warning.message:
You are using an older version of {APP_NAME} after using a later version. Please exit and download the latest version from {website}.

If you continue, it is VERY LIKELY that you will PERMANENTLY lose all of your settings and backpack. We WILL NOT be able to recover your data.

(Debug info: {debugInfo})
